LanguageData.CQFAction_HibernateMap_Tip: Hibernate the target's map, preserving the map and its things while stopping map and thing updates. Activation resumes the same map without regenerating it.
LanguageData.CQFAction_ActivateMap_Tip: Activate the target's hibernating map, returning the original map to the active map list and resuming updates without regenerating it.
